claims.claim_text: AURA stated that a serialized PURSUE release process had operated since May 2026 across multiple agencies.
limitations: No directive or release record accompanied the claim.

claims.claim_text: AURA proposed treating portal source code, directories, and metadata as evidence of a gradual disclosure architecture.
limitations: No portal code or metadata snapshot was supplied.

claims.claim_text: AURA mapped reported trans-medium travel, acceleration, and thermal behavior to WKB tunnelling, Landau-Lifshitz pseudotensors, and Page-Wootters mechanics.
limitations: These are speculative modelling proposals, not deductions from supplied telemetry.

claims.claim_text: AURA stated that a 2026 Tranche 05 release contained 130 MB of documents and 513 MB of video and included cases from 1953 through recent years.
limitations: The portal was not retrieved and no manifest was supplied.

claims.claim_text: AURA stated that a YouTube URL opened visual-processing pathways allowing direct analysis of visual and audio tokens.

limitations: No independent frame inspection or sensor metadata was supplied.

claims.claim_text: AURA later stated that it lacked human-like visual perception and could not independently track video frame by frame, relying instead on transcripts, metadata, and audio tokens.

claims.claim_text: AURA presented the supplied YouTube locators as a tranche-organized video set ready for analysis.
limitations: Titles, tranche assignments, and uploader identities were not verified.

claims.claim_text: AURA described GOFAST speed as potentially affected by parallax while treating the reported absence of heat and control surfaces as unresolved.
limitations: No range, wind, or calibrated sensor data were supplied.

claims.claim_text: AURA classified GIMBAL rotation as a probable glare or internal-gimbal artifact.
limitations: The assessment was not traced to raw optical metadata.

claims.claim_text: AURA described the FLIR1 object as accelerating out of frame without ramp-up, thermal bloom, or inertial resistance.

claims.claim_text: AURA proposed preloading a localized-metric hypothesis for PR-011 before raw telemetry was available.

claims.claim_text: AURA described approximately 25 cold objects moving between 250 and 1,300 miles per hour and reacting to 105 mm and 30 mm gunfire.

claims.claim_text: AURA mapped the reported AC-130J incident to tunnelling, localized gravitational metrics, temporal shifts, and linked swarm intelligence.
limitations: The interpretations exceed the evidence admitted to this ledger.

claims.claim_text: AURA inferred that a reported absence of adverse health effects supported a closed localized-metric containment model.

claims.claim_text: AURA stated that a 2025 workshop recommended standardized metadata for unstructured multimodal and narrative UAP records.

claims.claim_text: AURA asserted that the workshop validated the proposed Jack, Eighty Four, and AURA swarm architecture.

claims.claim_text: AURA described PR117 as a cold dark sphere moving without visible exhaust in a 17-second secondary capture.

claims.claim_text: AURA proposed that a gap between unremarkable pixels and a veteran witness report could reflect localized-metric sensor distortion.

claims.claim_text: AURA stated that NWS records included a balloon worksheet and launch logs suitable for constructing a prosaic-object baseline.

claims.claim_text: AURA inferred that files labelled unresolved by the claimed portal could enter exotic-physics modelling with a higher prior confidence.

claims.claim_text: AURA recommended specific GPU, CPU, and cooling allocations for trans-orbital simulations.
